What is Sahayak?

Sahayak means helper. Many elderly people find government offices, banks and hospitals hard to manage alone. Their children often live in another city. Sahayak sends a verified person to go with them, step by step.

Example

Mrs. Lakshmi (68) needs a pension form. Her daughter lives in Bangalore. She books a Sahayak in 2 minutes.

What can a Sahayak help with?

🏛️ Government offices

Aadhaar, pension, certificates, MeeSeva

  • Fill the forms
  • Stand in the queue
  • Submit the application

🏥 Hospital visits

Registration, finding the right room, reports

  • Go with them
  • Help at registration
  • Bring them home safely
No medical advice.

🏦 Bank visits

Forms, token, understanding the steps

  • Go along to the bank
  • Help fill the forms
  • Explain each step simply
You do the money part yourself.

📄 Documents

Print, scan, copy, organise

  • Print and scan
  • Make photocopies
  • Keep papers in order

🔧 Mechanical assistance

Bike, scooter, car, auto or home appliance (fan, pump, fridge) repair

  • Take the vehicle to a trusted mechanic
  • Explain the repair estimate simply
  • Stay with them and bring it back
A Sahayak does not repair. You pay the mechanic directly.

🚆 Travel and errands

Railway or airport help, medicine and groceries

  • Go with them to the station or airport
  • Pick up medicine and groceries
  • See them safely home

Safety and trust

🔒 Never share your OTP, PIN or password with anyone — not even a Sahayak.

A Sahayak will

  • Come with you to offices, banks and hospitals
  • Explain steps in simple words
  • Help fill forms and organise documents
  • Share proof of what was done

A Sahayak will never

  • Ask for or see your OTP, PIN or password
  • Operate your bank or UPI account
  • Give medical advice or treatment
  • Repair a vehicle or appliance themselves
  • Share your documents with anyone else

Every Sahayak has

  • Identity checked
  • Phone checked
  • Background checked
  • A Sahayak ID card
  • Ratings from customers
